2014_spell_mechanics.booming-blade.scali: At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8. At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 and the moving damage increases to 3d8. At 17th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 and the moving damage increases to 4d8.
